BackstoryDef.title: manufactorum child
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was pressed into service in a manufactorum while still a child due to a need for fine-detail work and a shortage of appropriate servitors. [PAWN_pronoun] has quite the manual dexterity to show for it, unlike the unfortunate ones who lost fingers or worse.

BackstoryDef.title: tech acolytum
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was selected to be trained among the acolyta of the Cult Mechanicus at a very young age. While acolyta are granted scarcely any more respect than other menials in Mechanicus society, [PAWN_pronoun] enjoyed the fruits of this training and developed a thirst for induction into the mysteries of the priesthood and its quest to transcend the flesh.

BackstoryDef.title: preservitor
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was deemed at a young age to be part of the surplus population of a Mechanicus-run facility, and was marked for servitorisation in future when the lobotomised workforce numbers required it. For whatever reason, [PAWN_pronoun] managed to escape this fate.

BackstoryDef.title: PDF cadet
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was enrolled as a Planetary Defence Force cadet at a young age, training with dummy weapons and doing basic drill in addition to regular labour or education.

BackstoryDef.title: recolliger child
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was born and raised on a derelict voidship being salvaged by a recolliger clan, who were dropped off decades before and hoped to be picked up by another ship at some point in the future.

BackstoryDef.title: hive juve
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Growing up among the labouring class of a crowded hive city, [PAWN_nameDef] is as close as can be to a typical Imperial citizen. [PAWN_pronoun] is used to crowds but unused to frontier living.

BackstoryDef.title: underhive juve
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in the dank and deteriorating lower levels of a hive city. Day to day survival was [PAWN_possessive] only concern.

BackstoryDef.title: voidship child
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was a child of a voidship clan tasked with menial maintenance of a machine none of them understood but regarded almost as divine. [PAWN_pronoun] is unused to open skies but good with [PAWN_possessive] hands.

BackstoryDef.title: eugenics child
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was selectively bred as part of a eugenics programme on a Mechanicus forge world. The programme intended to create ideal recruits for the forge's skitarii legion, but was far from a normal childhood for [PAWN_objective] even by the standards of the Cult Mechanicus.

BackstoryDef.title: skitarii vanguard
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was a member of the vanguard in a forgeworld's skitarii clades, trained and honed for war in the name of the Omnissiah. [PAWN_pronoun] has seen and survived combat against xenos, hereteks, and the Archenemy.

BackstoryDef.title: skitarii ranger
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was a member of the rangers in a forgeworld's skitarii clades, trained and honed for war in the name of the Omnissiah. [PAWN_pronoun] has seen and survived combat against xenos, hereteks, and the Archenemy.

BackstoryDef.title: magos
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was inducted as a ranking Magos of the Adeptus Mechanicus, and [PAWN_pronoun] has achieved a broad mastery of many disciplines in the pursuit of the Quest for Knowledge.
